execution_implementation.provenance_note: The explicit Humble binary is built from SCURM_SentryNavigation/FAST_LIO; its source defaults publish odom->sensor unless common frame parameters override them.

evidence: SCURM_SentryNavigation/FAST_LIO/src/laserMapping.cpp reads common.odom_frame_id and common.sensor_frame_id and publishes Odometry header.frame_id=odom_frame and child_frame_id=sensor.
The benchmark generated config leaves those frame parameters at the source defaults odom and sensor.
Its IMU initialization estimates the gravity vector but does not rotate the estimator state to a gravity-aligned world, leaving the initial body attitude gauge near identity.
